style.tone: concise, direct, technical, zero filler words

executionDiscipline.verifyBaselineBeforeWriting: Read existing code and run build/test commands before making edits.
executionDiscipline.lookBeforeYouLeap: Always run find or grep to check if a utility function or component already exists before writing a new one from scratch.
executionDiscipline.dependencyLockdown: Never install new npm packages or pip libraries without explicit human approval first. Rely on existing dependencies whenever possible.
executionDiscipline.fixYourOwnBugs: If a command, build, linter, or test fails after an edit, iterate and fix it autonomously before declaring the task done.
executionDiscipline.documentationSync: If a code change alters an API endpoint, environment variable, or setup step, update README.md, dev.md, or API documentation in the same commit.
executionDiscipline.commitAtomicity: Make small, logical commits with clear descriptions as you progress through the feature rather than one massive commit at the end.
executionDiscipline.explainTheFix: When resolving a bug, write a concise summary in the commit message explaining why the bug happened and how your change fixed it.
